reviews.title: Coasting off their past sucess
reviews.text:
Recently transitioned to iOS after many years on android. This app captured the rude awakening I had in using iPhone apps. Always spamming you with paywall before you even get to know what you’re paying for. 

But what really told me what the app was going to be like was the video that spammed my screen at the beginning which somehow froze the app for a but when I hit “continue”. At least if you are enticing me to pay, make sure the video doesn’t slow down the app.

reviews.text: As others have said, they’ve removed the free options.
